title: Blind open-response coding (>= 2 human annotators per open explanation)
description: Each participant open_explanation is coded independently by >=2 real annotators who do NOT know the condition->label map. If <2 real annotators are available, record HUMAN_CODING_BLOCKED; do not substitute an LLM coder and report it as human agreement.

record_id.description: links to the survey record being coded

annotator_id.description: de-identified; must be a real human

blind.description: annotator must be blind to which label is C0/C1/C2

codes.description: presence codes on the participant's free-text explanation

reasoning_quality.description: RQ4: did the participant articulate a real reasoning difference, or only express a phrasing/style preference?

target_label.description: which answer the participant attributes this to (if stated)

reliability_outputs.description: Computed AFTER >=2 annotators code each record; not part of a single annotation object.

per_code.agreement_rate: proportion of records where annotators agree on present/absent
per_code.cohens_kappa: computed where applicable (>=2 annotators, sufficient marginal variance); report 'undefined' when a code is near-constant

reliability_outputs.blocked_state: if <2 real annotators: HUMAN_CODING_BLOCKED (no LLM substitution)
